phrases.latin: Rajae avia, Theodōrī proavia, quae Osoitsae cum eīs habitat
phrases.english: Raja’s grandmother, Theo’s great-grandmother, who lives with them in Osoitsa (the gloss on Baba)

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 24, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
